|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">インペリアル・スター・デストロイヤー“タイラント”の艦長。有能なリーダー。帝国の将校には珍しく、艦と乗組員に愛情を注いでいる。軍に政治を持ち込むことを極端に嫌う。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Captain Lennox.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots (3 if the ship is Tyrant). If aboard a Star Destroyer, once during each of your control phases he may use that ship's Tractor Beam.

'''Lore:'''
Captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Tyrant. An able leader. Unlike most Imperial officers, he is devoted to his ship and crew. He strongly dislikes bringing politics into the service.
